messages.text:
The failed patch was caused by `src/styles.css` being a single minified line, so normal context hunks are brittle.

The remaining issue is not backend correctness; it is mobile click safety: sticky filters and the bottom dock can cover card action links during browser scrolling, so I’m adding scroll padding/margins with a minimal append-style CSS patch and rerunning the failed checks.
